usage: This is the standard, everyday way to ask someone where they are from in Cairo. It is used in both casual and semi-formal situations, though highly formal contexts use the respectful pronoun '7adretak'. The pronoun must change based on the gender and number of the person being addressed.

variants.label: to a man
variants.note: The standard casual form used when speaking to a single male.

variants.label: to a woman
variants.note: The standard casual form used when speaking to a single female.

variants.label: to a group
variants.note: Used when addressing two or more people.

variants.label: formal to a man
variants.note: Used to show respect to an older man, a customer, or someone in authority.

variants.label: formal to a woman
variants.note: Used to show respect to an older woman, a customer, or someone in authority.

examples.arabic: إِنْتَ بِتِتْكَلِّم عَرَبِي كُوَيِّس، إِنْتَ مِنْين؟
examples.english: You speak Arabic well, where are you from?

examples.arabic: لَوْ سَمَحْت يَا فَنْدِم، حَضْرِتَك مِنْين؟
examples.english: Excuse me sir, where are you from?
